candidates.change_summary: Replace the require condition to allow anyone to call sudicideAnyone (remove owner check), changing who can trigger selfdestruct.
Change the selfdestruct beneficiary to the stored owner instead of msg.sender, so the recipient after destruction differs.
Negate the require condition so only non-owners can call sudicideAnyone, altering who can trigger selfdestruct.
Replace selfdestruct with a no-op return, preventing contract destruction and thus changing post-call state.
Change the require to check for a different address (address(0)) so only zero address can call, effectively preventing normal owner from destructing.
